# basic-auth-credentials: the base64 of a `user:pass` after `basic` or `authorization` stays
# reported by `http-basic-auth`, whose value must decode to credentials, in a header, a curl flag,
# a header map and bare.
# format: <rule id> TAB <line>. the test expands the placeholder, so no opaque literal is stored here.
http-basic-auth	Authorization: Basic {BASIC_40}
http-basic-auth	curl -H "Authorization: Basic {BASIC_40}" https://api.example.com/v1
http-basic-auth	headers = {"Authorization": "Basic {BASIC_40}"}
http-basic-auth	auth = "basic {BASIC_40}"
http-basic-auth	authorization {BASIC_40}
http-basic-auth	Authorization: Basic Basic {BASIC_40}
